tagline: Sync Jira bugs to a Trello bug tracker board automatically
metaTitle: Jira + Trello Integration: Jira Bugs on a Trello Board
metaDescription: Mirror Jira bugs to a Trello tracker board and move cards when bug status changes. GAIA keeps both aligned. See the setup steps.
intro:
Engineering teams track bugs in Jira because of its tight integration with sprint boards and version management. But non-technical stakeholders — support managers, product owners, customer success leads — often prefer Trello for its visual clarity and accessibility. When bug information lives only in the issue tracker, the stakeholders who need to see it are locked out unless someone manually maintains a parallel board.

GAIA syncs bugs to Trello automatically so stakeholders get the visual bug tracker they prefer while engineering continues working in Jira. New bugs appear as cards. Status transitions move cards across lists. When a bug is resolved, its card updates automatically. Nobody has to maintain both boards.

This integration is most valuable for support and customer success teams that need visibility into bug resolution timelines without needing a login to the issue tracker, and for organizations that want a lightweight external bug visibility board without investing in dashboard configuration.

useCases.title: Mirror Jira bugs to a Trello bug tracker board
useCases.description: When a new bug is created, GAIA creates a corresponding card with the bug summary, priority, affected version, and a link back to the Jira issue so non-technical stakeholders have a current view of the bug queue.

useCases.title: Move Trello cards when Jira bug status changes
useCases.description: As a bug moves through the workflow, from Open to In Progress to In Review to Resolved, GAIA moves the matching card across the corresponding lists so the board always reflects bug status in real time.

useCases.title: Add the fix version to card labels
useCases.description: When engineering sets a fix version on a bug, GAIA adds the version as a card label so stakeholders can filter the board by release and understand which fixes are coming in which version.

useCases.title: Post bug comments to card activity
useCases.description: When an engineer adds an investigation update or resolution note to a bug, GAIA mirrors the comment to the card so support staff following it see the latest engineering notes without needing a login on the engineering side.

useCases.title: Escalate high-priority bugs to an escalation list
useCases.description: When a bug is marked as Critical or Blocker priority, GAIA creates or moves its card to a dedicated Escalations list on the board so critical bugs are visually prominent and easy to track.

howItWorks.step: Connect Jira and Trello to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Jira project and Trello account. Select the board and configure the list structure that should mirror your bug workflow stages.
Define which workflow statuses correspond to which lists and which issue fields should populate card title, description, labels, and due date.

howItWorks.step: Both views stay in sync automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA creates cards for new bugs and moves them as status changes. Engineering keeps working in the project; stakeholders watch the board; both views stay accurate.

faqs.question: Does GAIA sync all Jira issue types or only bugs?
faqs.answer: By default only issues of type Bug are synced. You can extend this to other issue types such as Tasks or Stories by configuring additional sync rules, each with its own board or list destination.

faqs.question: Can Trello users add comments that sync back to the issue?
faqs.answer: Yes, bidirectional comment sync is supported. When a card member adds a comment, GAIA posts it to the linked issue. You can restrict this to specific board members if you want to limit which comments flow back to the issue.

faqs.question: What happens when a bug is deleted?
faqs.answer: When a bug is deleted, GAIA archives the corresponding card rather than deleting it. This preserves the card history while keeping the active board clean. You can configure automatic deletion if preferred.
